manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Upward open mouth; soap low in bag; gravity-down hanging orientation; dry maintained reference. Final sunlight and sheltered-side aging depend on scene placement.
manufactureInstallation.agingCausality: Used soap has rounded corners in geometry. No arbitrary rust, algae, chalking, dirt or baked wet highlights. Dampness/residue masks not yet authored.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: Yarns, apertures, hook, eye, bindings and soap are real geometry. Fine fibre/soap texture is a low-amplitude material proxy, not source-photo texture.
manufactureInstallation.lod: All 32 yarns and functional parts retained at every level. 41 logical parts compacted to four material meshes; path and radial tessellation decrease. Unity draw calls, transition fidelity and performance are not measured.
